name: Scenic Repartee
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [language-dependent, mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, bloodrager 4, mesmerist 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration concentration, max 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You begin to recite a long comedy sketch which requires a certain fixed response from the public every time the actor says a catchphrase. At the beginning of each round, all enchanted creatures within range must attempt a saving throw. Anyone who fails the save is unable to do anything but scream the fixed response, while a successful save allows a creature to behave normally in that round. You may exclude creatures from the effect as you wish. Anyone attacking first an enchanted creature in a round in which it failed its save frees the creature from the spell effect; enchanted creatures can be attacked normally in rounds in which they succeeded at the save.

A variant of this spell could require that all enchanted creatures drop whatever they have in hand and clap their hands on cue for 1 round.
